info.title: ProcrastiMate agent API
info.description: The routes an AI account may call with its `pm.<ownerId>.<secret>` token.

Priority.description: Todoist priorities: 1 is the most urgent, 4 is the unmarked default.

ShareTarget.description: What a share reaches. `id` is empty for the whole space.

SpaceView.description: What the caller sees of a space, for the agent command API.

AgentNewTask.description: A task the agent command API adds. It needs `text` or `title`.

TaskEdit.description: The editable fields of a task. A missing field is left alone; for nullable fields, `null` clears the value.

ActivityEntry.description: One change to a task, read from the space’s log.

Person.description: A human, or an AI account with the human who owns it.

post.description: The apps’ replication protocol. `{ "cursor": 0, "ops": [] }` answers with the whole visible snapshot. A task op is applied when the task is editable before and after it; project and label ops are acknowledged and dropped.

get.description: The tasks, projects, and labels of the space, and the ids of visible tasks the caller may not edit.

post.description: `text` reads like the app’s quick add: dates, repeats, `p1` to `p4`, reminders, and `#Project` and `@label` for ones that exist. Explicit fields win over parsed ones.

patch.description: Only the fields sent change; `null` clears a nullable field.

delete.summary: Delete a task and its subtasks

post.description: A recurring task moves to its next date instead of closing.

get.description: Who created, edited, completed, reopened, or deleted the task, and when, oldest first.
